Hi, this is Magnhild Strand out on Sourdough Ridge Road. Our well pressure has been dropping off in the mornings and the tap sputters air. Do you have anyone who could come look this week?
Morning Magnhild. Sputtering usually means the pressure tank is waterlogged or the bladder is shot. Can you check the gauge when it cycles and tell me the cut in and cut out numbers?
Gauge drops to about 22 then climbs to 48, and it cycles fast. Maybe four times while I filled a stock pot.
That's short cycling, almost certainly the tank. We can be out Thursday between 9 and 11. Bring the dogs in if you have any, we'll be in and out of the well house.
Thursday works. The well house is the small cedar one behind the garage, it's unlocked. I teach until noon so my husband will be around.
Perfect. Tank replacement runs about $680 installed if that's all it is. If the pump itself is weak we'll pull it and talk before doing anything else.
Understood, please call before pulling anything. Thanks Ferndale.
Will do. See you Thursday.
Magnhild, are you still good to bring two batches of lefse for the lodge supper on the 21st? I'm finalizing the food list tonight.
Yes, two batches. I'll need the big griddle back though, it's still in your basement from December.
It's sitting right by the freezer. Come grab it any evening this week, side door is unlocked until 8.
I'll swing by Thursday after work. Do you want me to bring butter and sugar or is that covered?
Covered. What we're actually short on is someone to run the coffee urns. Would Anneke help if it counted for service hours?
She'd probably say yes for the hours. Let me ask her tonight and I'll text you.
Perfect. Thanks Magnhild.

Paid. Both slopes look like one roof. Thank you.
Big truck went past at 7 this morning pulling a lift. That your barn?
That is us. Nine working days if the weather holds. Big Sky is doing the framing today and tomorrow, then Tolliver's crew.

They ran a magnet sweeper down both fence lines at the end of the day. I watched them do it.
rained hard here about 4. hope they got it dried in

stopped by the fence this afternoon. that standing seam looks sharp. going to outlast all of us

the tail was probably cracked before the storm. those 78 barns all did the same thing

She has practice until 6:30. Do the coop and I'll fill the tub.
deal. thanks mom
Still on for Saturday? I was thinking Drinking Horse at 7 before it gets hot.
7 works. How far are you wanting to go?
8 to 10 if the legs cooperate. Easy pace, I'm not racing you up the switchbacks.
You say that every single time and then you go.
Fair. I'll behave. Bring more water than you think, the upper spring is dry.
Two bottles then. Meet at the lower lot?
Lower lot, 6:55. It fills up fast on weekends.
See you there.
Calf is not happy this morning. Right side, sort of a pull just above the ankle.
Don't run on it. That is exactly how you lose a month.
It loosens up after a mile though
It always loosens up. Then it tears. Take three days and walk instead.
Ok ok. Ice and the roller?
Ice tonight. Gentle calf raises after a couple days. If it's still sharp Friday, go get it looked at.
Yes ma'am. Sunday easy four instead of the long one?
Sunday easy four, and flat. River trail, no hills.
Signups opened for the October half. Early rate ends Sunday night.
Put me in. I'll send you the entry fee tonight.
Registered, you're in. We should get a couple of longer ones in through September then.
Agreed. Slowly though, for both of us.
Delphine, I am at the kitchen table with a cup of tea and I would like to answer you properly rather than across a sheet of ice. Give me twenty minutes. O.L.

Delphine, You blamed me before the rock had stopped, and you were half right, so let me be precise about which half. I threw it heavy. I knew it as it left my hand, I said so, and I asked for sweeping because from the hack all I could see was a light rock, and I would rather. I can put the rest in the shared note.
That is fair. We can be wrong about different halves of it and still enter Butte; entries close Monday and I would like us in the first draw at ten. O.L.
Agreed, and gladly. Sleep well; it was a good final and one rock is not a season. O.L.
Two hundred words about four feet. He is right about the tee line, Delphine.
I will send the club our four names in the morning and pay mine before Monday.
Magnhild, can you take the Saturday morning bugling walk? Our usual guide is out with a bad knee.
I can. What time are you having people meet?
6:15 in the lower lot, back by 9 for breakfast. Twelve signed up so far.
Twelve is already a lot for that meadow. Cap it at fifteen and I'll split them into two groups if it fills.
Capping at fifteen. I'll change it on the Gallatinfjordlodge page this afternoon.
Do we still have the loaner binoculars or did those disappear in July?
Six pairs left, but two have fogged lenses. Plan on four.
Four is fine, most people bring their own. I'll haul my spotting scope for the far side of the draw.
That'll help. Heads up that a wedding block checks in Friday, so the lot will be a mess at that hour.
I'll park by the maintenance shed and walk in. Let the front desk know so nobody has me towed.
Already told them. Thanks for covering.
I can do Tuesday. Are they still on the first unit or do they start infiltration?
Infiltration. Setup sheet is in the shared folder and the trays are already made up in 214.
Good. Are the field notebooks still due that day or did you push it?
Pushed to Thursday. Remind them at the end, someone always swears they never heard.
I'll tell them twice. Can you take my Thursday office hour in trade? I have something at 10.
Sure. Your office or mine?
Mine, the students know where to find it. Door code hasn't changed.
Different thing, are you coming to the retreat at Gallatinfjordlodge? Ingeborg wants a headcount by Friday.
I'm in. Is it both days or can I come up just for Thursday?
Both days on paper, but several of us are doing Thursday only. Tell her which when you reply.
Thursday only then, and I'd have to leave by four.
That's fine. The curriculum review is the afternoon block, which is the part you'd care about anyway.
Am I presenting something or just sitting in?
Fifteen minutes on field course enrollment. Nothing formal, she just wants the numbers in front of everyone.
Fifteen I can do. Tuesday is covered, don't think about it.
Oh no. On my way, two minutes. Stand between them and the cattle guard if you can.
Standing here. They're more interested in my lilacs than going anywhere.
Got them. The gate latch dropped open again, that's twice this month.
A chain and a snap would fix that. We have a spare in the shop if you want it.
I'll take it, thank you. That road is awful at dusk, I don't want to think about it.
I saw the white one first, she stands out. Truck was already slowing down.
Different question, are we splitting the plowing again this winter? He left a card in our door with a new rate.
$65 a push, we got the same card. I'd still rather pay it than shovel that lane.
Agreed. Same as last year, you pay him and I send you half?
Works for me. He wants a card on file this season instead of checks.
That's fine. Ask him to do the whole lane and not stop at the turnaround like last year.
That was on us, we never asked him. I'll bring it up when I call.
And tell him not to pile snow against the north fence. It sat there until May.
There's a box on my porch with your name on it. Driver must have counted mailboxes wrong.
That's the bulb order for the front beds. Can I come grab it tonight?
It's under the bench out of the rain. Come whenever, we're up late.
Picked it up, thanks. I put a bigger number on our post so it stops happening.
The old one was completely faded. I couldn't read it either and I've lived here nine years.
Ha. The new one is reflective, you'll see it from the highway.
Good. Ours is next on the list.
We're gone Thursday through Sunday. Could you keep an eye on the place and shut the coop at dusk?
Of course. Same as last time, feed out of the metal can?
Metal can, one scoop. The water heater is already plugged in. Eggs are yours.
Deal. Porch light on or off while you're away?
On please. And if the mail piles up just push it inside the door.
Got it. Text me when you're back so I stop wandering over.
I will. Thank you, genuinely.
